description: A set of durable memory changes. Omitted operation arrays contain no changes.

append.description: New facts not already represented by the memory manifest.

text.description: A self-contained fact supported by the conversation.

evidence.description: How the fact is supported; omitted values are treated as inferred.

entity.description: The destination: project (the current scope), profile, project:<id>, or artifact:<id>. Omit to use the current scope. Use only identifiers present in the conversation.

category.description: An existing user-defined category name whose guidance fits the fact; otherwise omit.

replace.description: Corrections or consolidations of mutable facts identified in the manifest.

text.description: The complete replacement fact, preserving still-valid identifiers and details.

evidence.description: The replacement's evidence type; omit to preserve the existing type.

remove.description: Identifiers of mutable manifest facts that the conversation establishes should be removed.
